source_of_values: Proposed design choices, not experimental observations

generation.prng_plan: common uniform keyed by question_id, seed, generation_step; inverse CDF in token-ID order; exact PRNG pending
generation.top_p_boundary: descending probability, ascending token_id ties, include threshold crossing token; top_p=1 uses all allowed vocabulary
generation.prompt_policy: user-only problem plus step-by-step and boxed-answer instruction; reasoning-start prefix once, after template verification

data.calibration_source: 128 disjoint GSM8K train problems with generated reference traces
data.split_selection: SHA256 of normalized question, ascending; tie row_index; consecutive disjoint 128 calibration / 128 development / 128 pilot; replace duplicate train candidates with audit
data.duplicate_policy: exclude exact/near test duplicates from train candidates before outputs; keep official test; near-match method pending development freeze
data.calibration_input: prompt plus F-generated text; no gold answer in input; only after approval
data.primary_accuracy: final boxed numeric answer after completed reasoning; parse failure/missing final answer incorrect; cap with valid final answer scored, cap flag separate

estimand.L: mean consumed generation tokens including reasoning and final answer under fixed cap
estimand.interpretation: Controlled-policy recovery ratio, not a unique natural mediation fraction
estimand.probability_preservation: Q logits and relative weights within permitted support are retained; normalization changes absolute probabilities

inference.primary_support_rule: ratio eligibility AND one-sided 95% lower C_0.50 > 0 AND one-sided 95% lower accuracy_contrast > -0.03
inference.unstable_denominator_rule: If ratio eligibility fails, no ratio inference; report Delta and D with CIs; not H1 refutation
inference.secondary_families: Freeze before confirmation; Holm correction for confirmatory secondary claims
inference.bootstrap_method: paired question-cluster percentile; numpy-style linear quantile interpolation
inference.primary_test_logic: intersection-union; each support component one-sided alpha .05; C_r decision is authoritative, ratio CI descriptive
inference.global_refutation_multiplicity: Bonferroni across two component-refutation tests: eligible AND upper97.5(C_0.50)<0, OR upper97.5(accuracy_contrast)<-0.03; individual endpoint summaries use one-sided95 bounds
inference.missing_run_policy: replay exact failed task; do not drop questions or encode infrastructure errors as short outputs; incomplete plan cannot receive final H1 classification

claims_not_authorized_by_this_design: Real low-bit hardware speedup from simulated quantization
Benchmark pretraining contamination has been eliminated
